relations: The raised left arm slowly lowers and rotates, bending at the elbow so an open palm faces the mirror.
As the left arm descends, the head straightens from its upward tilt and turns slightly toward the mirror.
The mirror reflection continuously tracks the lowering arm and straightening head.
The right arm, torso, and bare feet remain stationary throughout the left arm's descent.
caption: The video captures a dance studio lined with a full-width mirror wall, framed pictures mounted above it, and a string of small lights running along its base. A woman with dark hair in a bun, wearing a long-sleeved patterned top and black trousers, stands barefoot with her back to the camera, facing the mirror so that only her reflection appears as a second figure. Her right arm hangs at her side and her feet stay planted throughout. This mid-segment shows an ongoing arm movement: her raised left arm, already extended diagonally upward at the first frame, slowly lowers and rotates. The hand, pointing high above her head at the opening frame, progressively drops toward shoulder height. The elbow bends so that an open palm faces the mirror. As it descends, the head, which had tilted upward toward the hand in the reflection, gradually straightens and turns slightly. The mirror tracks these arm and head changes exactly. Meanwhile the body, feet, and right arm remain essentially static, with no camera movement evident.
